[LADP.4.4.1] Required slots when the adapter is author-declared:

| Slot | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `topic` (or per-adapter equivalent key) | STRING | The external system's identifier for this fact. Authors match it directly in `where` ([LADP.3.1]). |
| `retained` | BOOL | Whether this fact came from the source system's retention mechanism (MQTT retained message, etc.) vs a live publish. See [LADP.8]. |
